title: Explicit feedback-ingestion tool-call mining from structured session events
detail: Grounds the captured tool-name schema against real .session/sessions/* transcripts (confirmed: real sessions have zero role=tool SessionTurns across 61 files/2670 turns; tool call/result metadata lives in the separate CopilotHookEvent 'tool.execution_result' events, not turns). Adds ExplicitIngestion signal mining over events (matching feedback_ingest tool-name suffix, parsing tool_arguments_json verbatim), and a recover_feedback_entry_from_signal builder that only persists when the live call did not already succeed (avoiding duplicate entries). No SessionTurn.content inspection anywhere.
